clients.name: Integration — Catalog (read-only)
clients.description: Sample per-tenant machine client (issue #206 [AI-4]). Client-credentials grant, service-account only, granted catalog:read ONLY — proves least-privilege catalog access: 200 on GET /api/v1/products, 403 on any product write.

clients.name: Integration — Orders (read-write)
clients.description: Sample per-tenant machine WRITE client (Phase 25 [AI-02] / #204). Client-credentials grant, service-account only, granted orders:write + customers:write + catalog:read (write + read-for-discovery) — least-privilege agent credential: can create orders/customers and read the catalog, but pointedly NOT catalog:write. RLS walls cross-tenant.

clientScopes.name: catalog:read
clientScopes.description: Read-only access to the product catalog surface (issue #206 [AI-4]). Emitted into the token scope claim; the resource server maps it to SCOPE_catalog:read.

clientScopes.name: catalog:write
clientScopes.description: Write access to the product catalog surface (issue #206 [AI-4]). Emitted into the token scope claim; the resource server maps it to SCOPE_catalog:write, which gates all nine ProductController mutations.

clientScopes.name: orders:read
clientScopes.description: Reserved taxonomy scope for the [AI-1] MCP auth model (#203). DEFINED to seed the capability taxonomy; NOT granted to any client and NOT enforced in this slice.

clientScopes.name: orders:write
clientScopes.description: Enforced (Phase 25 [AI-02]): gates POST /api/v1/orders via @PreAuthorize(hasAuthority('SCOPE_orders:write')). Emitted into the token scope claim; the resource server maps it to SCOPE_orders:write.

clientScopes.name: customers:read
clientScopes.description: Reserved taxonomy scope for the [AI-02] MCP auth model (Phase 25). DEFINED for taxonomy symmetry with catalog:*/orders:*; NOT granted to any client and NOT enforced in this slice.

clientScopes.name: customers:write
clientScopes.description: Enforced (Phase 25 [AI-02]): gates POST /api/v1/customers via @PreAuthorize(hasAuthority('SCOPE_customers:write')). Emitted into the token scope claim; the resource server maps it to SCOPE_customers:write.

clientScopes.name: acr
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add acr (authentication context class reference) to the token

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token
